title: After the Yasuda Kinen: A Consolatory Bath

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Ikuno Dictus is in top form and defeats Matikanetannhauser.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Matikanetannhauser stays optimistic despite her frustration. Ikuno Dictus kindly tells her, "I didn't let my guard down because you were here."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Afterward, she invites Matikanetannhauser to a bathhouse.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Time to fully recover and focus on the next race!
